integrity: An all-length graph-and-periodicity proof is included; finite verification is supplementary. Literature inspection is not an independent historical-priority determination.
scientific_limitations: The optimum concerns circular binary words, all indexed length-n factors with exactly two ones, and n>=4; no assertion for weight three or higher, linear covers, reversal equivalence, or classification of all optimal words.
title: A sharp circular covering law for binary words of weight two
